development_findings.finding: Regression fixture SQLite context manager did not close its inspection connection, preventing Windows temporary-directory cleanup.
development_findings.resolution: Use contextlib.closing; production connection cleanup unchanged.

development_findings.finding: An os.walk fault injection initially also intercepted shutil.rmtree cleanup.
development_findings.resolution: Restrict injection to the reviews tree; actual inaccessible subtree still fails closed.
